claims.statement: Most AI Act rules entered application in August 2026, while high-risk timelines extend into 2027-2028, creating staged evidence, registration and governance work.
Providers and deployers of potentially high-risk systems have a compliance event, but the exact buyer segment and willingness to use a standalone evidence product remain unverified.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: AI product head, compliance officer or CIO
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Evidence captured automatically from model-development tools; governance suites and consultants can bundle
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business under direct AI-provider contracts
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: AI development agencies, ISO auditors, law firms and targeted outbound

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Annual subscription prepaid plus onboarding milestone
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 70-85% after cloud and compliance review
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Connector maintenance, onboarding and evidence-quality support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security audit, legal updates, insurance and subprocessors
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Workspace subscription by system and evidence volume
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Storage, model/API calls, integrations and specialist review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: MLOps, GRC and cloud vendors add AI Act evidence features
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Readiness assessment, conformity preparation or customer audit requiring retrievable AI-system evidence
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: High-risk classification, enterprise procurement diligence or regulatory milestone
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual compliance cycle and each material model/system change

contrary_evidence: Timeline simplification and delayed high-risk rules may defer urgency.
Many systems will not be high-risk and can use generic document tools.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: No current integration rights; proposed workflow-integration agreement and customer-authorized connectors
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Offer exportable evidence templates or integrate with another development stack
critical_control_point.current_owner: Customers and their MLOps/cloud vendors control development evidence
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business under direct AI-provider contracts
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No employer AI systems, documents or customer relationships are required or assumed
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business after signed customer authorization
critical_control_point.subject: Continuous AI-system evidence capture and audit vault

economics.acquisition_route: Sell three fixed-fee evidence gap assessments, connect one common MLOps stack, then convert to annual workspaces
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 500 workspaces at 24,000 PLN ARR and 25% EBITDA yields 3m PLN EBITDA; 5-7x could exceed 5m founder value in years 6-9. Competitive pricing and high-risk volume are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly; compliance content can be partner-reviewed
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less cloud, connector maintenance and specialist QA
economics.payback: Assumption: 10-15 customers recover build and legal costs within 18 months
economics.pricing: Assumption: 8,000-25,000 PLN onboarding plus 1,000-5,000 PLN monthly
economics.retention_or_repeat: Evidence accumulates across versions, audits and customer reviews

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Machine-readable evidence mappings across MLOps tools and audit outcomes
fingerprint.customer: CEE AI providers and enterprise AI teams
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Continuous evidence vault sold as SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: AI provider pays when audits or procurement require system evidence
fingerprint.problem_trigger: AI systems reach regulated operating states without continuous evidence capture

founder_fit: Direct match to data science and AI workflows.

structure.control_point: Embedded evidence ledger across model changes
structure.critical_dependency: MLOps integrations and correct legal classification

thesis: Future state: regulated AI systems ship with continuously updated technical and governance evidence. The missing coordination mechanism is an evidence vault connected to development workflows rather than a periodic spreadsheet exercise.
title: AI Act Continuous-Evidence Vault
